legenda:
8 tourist traps in Brazil, in 20 seconds 👀
📱 Phone snatching: check maps inside a shop, not on the curb
🚕 Fake taxis: app rides or official airport counters only
💳 Card machines: read the amount on the screen before you tap
🏧 ATMs: use the ones inside banks or malls
🎁 "Free" ribbons in Pelourinho: smile, say no, keep walking
🏖️ Beach: never leave your bag alone on the sand
🧭 Tours: licensed guides only (ICMBio badge in Lençóis)
💱 Money: skip street changers, use a bank or your card
